reviewed_by: orchestrator (Opus), phase 4, code reviewed for approved hooks only

statuses.approved: code reviewed; installed by bootstrap when default_enabled
statuses.inventory-only: not selected (no demonstrated value, out of scope or replaced by an own control); harmless, kept for reference
statuses.rejected: incompatible with hub policy (privacy, global writes, memory conflicts, token cost)

own.notes: Denies subagents outside sonnet/haiku, fork, model-less built-ins and xhigh/max effort. Cannot be disabled.

Own deterministic replacement for ECC pre:bash:dispatcher and gateguard: denies destructive, remote-execution, global-config and guard-tampering commands; asks for force push, hard reset, clean -fdx and global package installs.
Denies edits to model_guard.py, MODEL_POLICY.json and hook scripts, and content with credential patterns; asks for .claude/settings.json edits and paths outside the project.
Own replacement for ECC stop:cost-tracker: stores only token counts per model and subagent in .agent-hub/usage/ (project-local, no content). Never blocks.

pre:config-protection.reason: Reviewed: reads stdin (1 MB cap) and lstat of the target only; no writes, network, child processes or credentials. Blocks edits that weaken existing linter/formatter configs. Requires node; fails open if node is missing.

pre:bash:dispatcher.reason: Broad dispatcher (quality, tmux, push, GateGuard) with many dependencies; replaced by own:command-guard.

pre:powershell:gateguard-fact-force.reason: 2,848 lines plus 5 libraries and on-disk state; replaced by own:command-guard.

pre:write:doc-file-warning.reason: Conflicts with the hub documentation workflow (WORK_LOG, reports).

pre:edit-write:suggest-compact.reason: State kept through shared libraries outside the hook; Claude Code already auto-compacts; benefit not demonstrated.

pre:observe:continuous-learning.reason: Captures tool-use observations (conversation capture); conflicts with future Agent Memory/OpenViking.

pre:governance-capture.reason: Captures governance events including secrets; privacy risk.

pre:mcp-health-check.reason: Manages MCP health state and reconnection; no new MCP in scope.

pre:edit-write:gateguard-fact-force.reason: Denies the first edit of every file with questions: extra turns and tokens; very high complexity.

pre:hookify-runtime.reason: Generic rule engine with no project rules defined; evaluate later.

prompt:hookify-runtime.reason: Generic rule engine with no project rules defined; evaluate later.

user-prompt:context-gate.reason: Opt-in stop-and-restart at 90% context reading the transcript; benefit not demonstrated.

pre:compact.reason: Persists session state (memory) outside the project; conflicts with Agent Memory.

session:start.reason: Loads previous session context (memory); conflicts with Agent Memory/OpenViking.

session-start:plan-canvas-sessions.reason: Depends on ECC Plan Canvas browser UI.

post:dispatcher:sync.reason: Runs ECC-internal PostToolUse hooks (formatting, telemetry); too broad.

post:dispatcher:async.reason: Runs ECC-internal background PostToolUse hooks; too broad.

post:mcp-health-check.reason: MCP reconnection logic; no new MCP in scope.

post:skill:track.reason: Skill-health telemetry stored outside the project.

stop:hookify-runtime.reason: Generic rule engine with no project rules defined; evaluate later.

stop:plan-canvas-pending.reason: Depends on ECC Plan Canvas browser UI.

stop:format-typecheck.reason: JS/TS specific (Biome/Prettier/tsc through npx); not a default for Godot projects.

stop:session-end.reason: Persists session state (memory) after each response.

stop:evaluate-session.reason: Extracts patterns from sessions (continuous learning, conversation capture).

stop:cost-tracker.reason: Writes to ~/.claude/metrics and the OS temp dir (outside the project); replaced by own:usage-tracker.

stop:desktop-notify.reason: Desktop notifications; no value for the hub.
